identitySignals: Name matches: Discovery Education Specialists is a California company offering psychoeducational evaluations and mental health services to school districts, consistent with OUSD's special education nonpublic agency master contract
Own website says it serves the Bay Area and describes itself as SELPA approved, but lists Livermore, CA as its base rather than Walnut Creek as in the agenda

A Solano County SELPA provider list reportedly shows a Walnut Creek location for its owner, but no cited page links the organization to Walnut Creek or to OUSD, and no registry record (Secretary of State, SAM.gov) was confirmed
research.notes: Agenda gives Walnut Creek, CA; the vendor's website points to Livermore, CA. Could not confirm the Walnut Creek link, an OUSD link, or any registry entry. Contact details omitted because the location mismatch is unresolved.

profile.summary: Discovery Education Specialists is a company that provides psychoeducational evaluations, Independent Educational Evaluations, counseling and behavior support for students with disabilities. It works with school districts and families in the Bay Area and the Sacramento and San Joaquin Valleys.
